note: Reviewed labels for the eight root-level sample clips. Every field records HOW it was reviewed: `contact-sheet` means sparse stills were inspected (docs/TECHNIQUE-PIPELINE-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md, section 2); `unreviewed` means the value is a pipeline output kept as a suggestion, never as ground truth. Per-error intervals are given only where a reviewer marked one. Existing model outputs are annotation suggestions.

labels.movement: one of barra.movements.MOVEMENTS, or `unknown` for a clip that shows no supported movement
labels.reps: reviewed completed repetitions, or null when not reviewed
labels.errors: [{errorId, rep, intervalS, status}] from the rule registry; empty when unreviewed
labels.forbidden: [{errorId, why}] checks that must not fire on this clip
labels.phaseScoped: [{errorId, phase, maxWindowS, why}] checks that may fire only from the named phase, over a window no longer than maxWindowS
labels.notReps: [{intervalS, why}] intervals that must not be retained as repetitions
labels.windows: reviewed source-time windows with their own movement and count labels; the full source label may remain unreviewed
labels.unobservable: checks a reviewer judged impossible from this footage, with the reason
labels.view: SAGITTAL | OBLIQUE | FRONTAL | UNKNOWN, as reviewed

phaseScoped.why: whole-rep arm-straightness labelled the normal elbow flexion of the pull as a fault; the check may fire, but only from the support window at the top, and the payload must say so. Whether the top was in fact locked out has not been reviewed frame by frame - the contact sheet is not enough to assert it.

clips.notes: Two completed muscle-ups. Baseline fired the whole-rep bent-arms rule on both.
Hanging knee raises under camera rotation. Recognition should be preserved; the count has not been reviewed frame by frame.
Night footage. Retained as a visibility case; count unreviewed.

notReps.why: 2 fps contact sheet across the entire first-30-second window shows approach, static hang, then drop/walk-away; no completed muscle-up ascent/transition

windows.why: 2 fps contact sheet shows no completed ascent or transition anywhere in this source window

clips.notes: No completed muscle-up is visible in the first 30 s (2 fps contact sheet); the full-source count remains unreviewed. This whole-window constraint subsumes the earlier walking interval at 22.61-25.16 s and dead-hang interval at 26.6-29.9 s. Recovery of true reps is assessed separately and must not come from relaxing the hand gate.
Static / inverted hold. No repetition may be counted.
Poor hand visibility. Abstention is the expected result unless new evidence supports recognition.
Attempt/swing footage needing temporal review. Neither a completed pull-up nor an unknown label is asserted here; the movement label is left null so it does not enter the confusion matrix.

unobservable.why: the viewpoint is not knowable, so the sagittal hip line cannot be judged

forbidden.why: the baseline fired stall on 17 of 19 smooth repetitions with the phases reversed; a genuine mid-lift pause must still fire, but the set as filmed is continuous

clips.notes: Nineteen push-ups. The baseline's phase timing was reversed (concentric/eccentric).
